description: Unpadded all-K96 FP4 Gluon experiment: final same-input sweep and rejected-design screens
notes: Native K64 and mixed controls retain original five-buffer/N64 configuration.
MXFP4 raw and pure use six buffers/N32; NVFP4 raw and pure use five buffers/N64.
All six final points have the same experimental source SHA; the first was measured before its source commit.
Final medians use seven alternating samples; do_bench_cudagraph replays each constructed graph ten times.
Clocks are not locked. No L2 flushing. K is divisible by 768; no padded reduction tail.
The pure/raw comparison isolates the instruction stream within the same producer and epilogue configuration.
Exact-transfer screens multiply and transfer no padding, but 128-byte swizzle sectors reserve unused SMEM bytes.
Raw inline-PTX memory operations are not fully modeled by Triton ConSan.
